changelog: - **High contrast, light theme: a selected node’s state lines can be followed at the overview.** With a Windows contrast theme on, the value-change, condition and trigger lines of a selected node stayed as thin as every other state line, a quarter of a pixel at the overview, while the node’s flows were already drawn at 2 px on screen. Over a light contrast theme those lines now keep 2 px on screen as well, at every zoom. Their dashes are the same, and no other line changes. A dark contrast theme is left as it was: there the same lines already showed. The wider dotted line covers more of a thin line that runs right beside it, so that neighbour is harder to follow while the node is selected.
